svg.title: .gitignore: skip untracked files.
svg.desc: Save a lowercase .gitignore in the repository's top directory. Its filename is outside the file drawing; its only contents are the pattern *.tmp, which matches names ending in .tmp. A matching scratch.tmp remains untracked, meaning not yet staged or committed. Ignore rules normally omit these files from status and addition, but do not remove tracked files or erase old commits. Secrets must not be committed.
svg.text: This file lists patterns Git normally omits from status and file addition.
Save .gitignore in your repository's top directory; keep its name lowercase.
Untracked = not yet staged or committed. Matching untracked files stay out.
Already tracked? An ignore rule does not remove the file from Git.
Check git status. Don't commit passwords or keys.
Ignoring a file does not erase secrets from old commits.
